title: North Bridge Venture Partners — claimed by thegentlemen
description: US · Financial Services · northbridge.com North Bridge Venture Partners one of Boston's most storied venture capital firms, founded in 1994 by Bill Geary, Doug Kingsley, Ed Anderson, Mike Pehl, and Richard D'Amore — ~$3.5B under management across 8 funds, ~200+ investments, 100+ exits, and 14 unicorns. Legendary portfolio: Demandware (sold to Salesforce for $2.8B), Starent Networks ($2.9B to Cisco), Proto Labs (IPO), Couch
